authorization_basis: Current user explicitly renewed authorization for necessary paid tests after the previous experiment reported a new uncertain provider outcome. This is a new finite exception with all known uncertainty recorded, not provider reconciliation, an old-parent replacement, ordinary startup unhalt or permission to ignore future failures.
registration: Separate quarantine-set tables bind sorted complete unchanged uncertain rows, ledger meta, old authorization history, explicit human reference, immutable method/source/input/slot fingerprints, exact fresh context-derived identities and finite fully-backed cap. No old parent ID is supplied or revived.

limits.reserved_amount: Exact existing verified model rate applied to frozen input/output bound. Holds, settled cost and every outstanding allowance share the original global ceiling.

fail_closed: Changed/missing quarantine row, decreased hold, changed meta or authorization history
Any new uncertain request, provider mismatch, cost overrun or explicit halt
Already registered protocol, used request or cross-scope invocation identity
Unregistered request, bound/model/phase/attempt change or invalid context-derived ID
Invalid ledger registration, event history or slot fingerprint
Closed/revoked/exhausted grant; replay cannot refill or reopen it
control_policy: Synthetic disposable ledgers and mock provider only. Same pre-implementation controls must pass after implementation; the one historical singleton refusal already passes before implementation. New paid calls remain forbidden until root reviews the implementation and registers clean-source immutable experiment slots.
